				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Vietnam’s First and Only<br>Premium All-Inclusive Programme </h1>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f573f76 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="f573f76" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The Pandanus Resort is proud to offer Vietnam’s first true Premium All-Inclusive experience – a concept created for guests who value comfort, freedom, and exceptional hospitality.</p><p>While all guests enjoy access to the resort’s unique Mui Ne walking tour, daily activities including yoga and tai chi classes, leisure facilities, and in-room minibar snacks, this exclusive package takes your stay to the next level, delivering a seamless and truly indulgent holiday.</p><p>All meals and beverages are included without restriction – from à la carte or buffet-style lunch and dinner to handcrafted cocktails at the Waterfall Lounge, unlimited orders from the resort’s extensive wine list, room service at any hour, and the weekly &#8216;<strong>The Taste of Mui Ne</strong>&#8216; seafood barbeque with live entertainment. Every outlet, every item, any time of day – all covered.</p><p>The package also includes one complimentary one-hour massage or spa treatment per person per day, along with Vietnamese cooking classes and curated culinary experiences. With no bills to sign and nothing held back, the Premium All-Inclusive programme is the most generous and carefree way to experience the Pandanus Resort and the natural beauty of Mui Ne.</p>								</div>
				</div>
